prediction_time_contract: Prediction is made at dispatch/en-route time, before travel begins. A feature is admissible only if its value is knowable at that instant.

en_route_at.reason: target component; used only to build the label and the temporal split

dispatched_at.reason: raw timestamp; used for the temporal split, not as a feature

is_synthetic.reason: dataset flag — filter, never a feature

is_training_eligible.reason: eligibility flag — filter, never a feature

unavailable_production_features.bearing: requires partner/pickup coordinates — absent from this dataset
unavailable_production_features.route_efficiency: requires straight-line vs travelled distance — coordinates absent
unavailable_production_features.average_speed: derivable but leaks the target (distance / duration)

leakage_controls: target and its components never enter the feature matrix
temporal split so no future row informs a past fold
no target-derived aggregate (e.g. average speed) constructed
